attributes.action: Arrest people who have done sexual assault,rape and domestic violence
attributes.additional_details: This is about sexual assault rape and domestic violence nobody should have to go through this alone most people always get away with serious crimes like this we need to put a stop to it
attributes.background: To stop and arrest people that have committed rape and domestic violence they should all be locked up and giving a 10 year sentence

rejection.details: The Police already have powers to arrest people if there is evidence they have committed one of these crimes. We are not sure how you would like this to change.
